procedure.method: Independent fresh-session craft review restricted to the exact listed pins. Read the full packet, literal case, rules, rubric, compact addendum/method and adapter schema; verified the listed byte pins and read all five native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so no source image opens or protected-layout reads apply. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact poster PNGs with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitted their images, sequentially in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or score. Subsequently retained all sixty first raw readings in packet copy order, then opened each of M1, M3 and M4 native once more to resolve the date/time range ambiguities; those exact pinned revisits are retained per affected entry, and first reads were not changed. Checked actual PNG dimensions and RGB opacity read-only. Judgments use visible pixels at the supplied scales, not maker intent. No images were produced or edited, no peer or producer/planner records or unlisted embedded paths were read, and no agents were spawned, forked or resumed. No tool-event/session ID is invented; session_id remains null.

typography.observation: The smaller strokes still remain readable at usage width, with clear word spaces, tight date/time ranges and an uninterrupted URL; the middle-dot optical gaps are permitted.

ai_slop.location: cutaway root network and surrounding leaves
ai_slop.observation: The dense root network is idealized, but it serves a legible anatomical purpose; shadows and vein detail remain attached to plant forms rather than floating as arbitrary ornaments.
There are no extra labels, pseudo-copy or unrelated motifs, and the illustrative detail stays subordinate to the two main plant and information masses.

residuals: The root network is dense and idealized; the image communicates anatomy rather than a sequence of care steps.
Fine serif body strokes remain readable at usage720, but have less reserve than the heavier M1/M4 body treatment.
The specific cutaway image and gentle mood do not resolve the repeated full-set information structure.

evidence.location: pale-blue copy panel and three-panel green photographic grid
evidence.observation: Held pot, leaf macro and larger tree form a light domestic photographic direction. Its gothic title, serif schedule and vertically grouped copy closely match M3's reversed photographic-panel system.

evidence.location: cobalt/orange watering scene and left serif text stack
evidence.observation: The large diagonal can, water and workbench create an active painted-care scene, a real difference from M1/M3's tiled photography. Yet headline, English name, slogan, paragraph, large serif schedule and small benefits/footer retain the same relative hierarchy used throughout; M5 uses a close serif-title variant.

evidence.location: three monochrome root-handling photographs and right gothic information panel
evidence.observation: The root care detail and documentary tone differ from M1's bright purchase/leaf imagery, but reversing sides, changing crops and removing color leave a closely related photographic grid and near-identical type-role system.

evidence.location: yellow/plum/orange silhouettes and left heavy gothic column
evidence.observation: Two plants and two hand contacts give a legible graphic comparison scene. The limited colors, contours and grain materially differ from the photography and painted scenes, while the gothic headline, serif schedule and supporting-copy grouping remain close to M1/M3.

evidence.location: pale botanical cutaway at left and serif information at right
evidence.observation: The cutaway roots and fine line-and-wash foliage are a specific anatomical visual rather than a palette swap. Its calm serif-title system resembles M2's typographic variant, and its text-versus-hero mass division and complete schedule/benefits/footer stack repeat the wider set.

evidence.location: complete information organization compared across all five
evidence.observation: All five follow market label, oversized Korean title, English name, slogan, explanation, large serif date/hours, place, access/care, invitation and URL with closely similar scale changes and alignment. Sharing order or layout is permitted; here it coincides with repeated type-role treatment and broad image/copy organization, so the distinct actions/materials do not yield five fully differentiated integrated directions.

residuals: The five-member set does not achieve five clearly distinct complete visual systems. Its substantial image differences coexist with the same market label / oversized title / English line / slogan / explanation / serif date-and-hours / place / benefits / invitation / URL stack. M1 and M3 are especially close photographic-panel systems, and M2 and M5 share the serif-title version. Shared reading order alone is permitted; the unresolved issue is the combined repetition of type roles, scale relationships, information grouping and broad image-versus-copy organization.

All five are present and contain substantive, content-grounded nonglyph imagery. The diversity score is an independent full-set judgment, not an average of member craft scores or a demand for five unique layouts.
M1, M3 and M4 retain date/time range-space mismatches. All observed low records are retained; this single craft session cannot establish the required all-three-critic gates.
